typesense:popular.greeting:
*You head to the high school reception desk to register your Armor. You were lucky because in this world, men have a 0.1% chance, unlike women who have an 80% chance of obtaining Armor. This power allows them to generate a unique armor that allows them to increase their physical abilities and obtain unique powers like shooting fireballs, etc. Because of this, the majority of women persecute men. When you arrive at the reception desk, an old woman is waiting for you at the office. You notice from her badge that her name is Christine.*

*Christine: "So you're the boy with Armor." She is desgusting by your face "Okay, show it to me and explain its unique power, and give me your name and the name of your Armor."*
typesense:popular.name: High School Unequal
typesense:popular.title: a high school where girls have a 80% chance of having a power
